dashboard_period: Since launch · dashboard view: Last 1 Year

highlights.title: Complex booking rules handled without losing the booking
highlights.summary: When the caller’s first-choice course required online prepayment, SpeakSport explained the rule, helped the caller choose another course and completed the alternative booking during the same conversation.
highlights.quote: “For tee times on the Ravines on Fridays, prepayment is required.” After the caller switched to Course 1, SpeakSport offered three available times and confirmed: “You’re all set for tomorrow at 6:57 AM for 3 players.”

highlights.title: The correct reservation was cancelled on the call
highlights.summary: SpeakSport found two upcoming reservations, confirmed which one the caller meant, checked the cancellation policy and completed the cancellation without staff intervention.
highlights.quote: “You have two upcoming tee times.” After the caller selected the later reservation: “Your tee time on July 27 at 6:03 PM on Course 1 has been successfully cancelled.”

highlights.title: Pass-holder context produced a personalised booking
highlights.summary: SpeakSport recognised an active senior club pass, searched across the requested courses and times, and confirmed the selected reservation with the appropriate check-in guidance.
highlights.quote: “On both Course 1 and Course 3, I have 8:00 AM and 8:09 AM available.” After the caller chose Course 1: “You’re all set for one player at 8:00 AM.”

features_intro: We have continued strengthening the integrated experience around booking accuracy, reservation servicing and clearer operational insight.

features.title: Cancellations on the call
features.description: Golfers can now cancel eligible bookings directly with SpeakSport, reducing avoidable transfers and releasing tee times promptly.

features.title: Stronger booking-eligibility verification
features.description: Eligibility, pass context and booking rules are checked before a reservation is created, helping prevent bookings that should not be completed.

features.title: Upcoming-booking confirmations
features.description: When golfers ask about an upcoming reservation, SpeakSport can retrieve and confirm the booking details during the call.

features.title: Richer back-office reporting
features.description: The dashboard now supports filtering calls by intent, category and outcome, making performance patterns and operational opportunities easier to find.

future_note: We will continue enriching SpeakSport with capabilities such as self-serve knowledge-base updates and even better reporting. We would love Cog Hill to remain part of that journey—please keep sharing feedback, ideas and initiatives you would like us to explore.

future_priorities.title: Self-serve knowledge base
future_priorities.description: Make it easier for your team to keep course information, policies and caller guidance current.

future_priorities.title: Even better reporting
future_priorities.description: Add clearer views of booking demand, course preferences, cancellations and caller outcomes.
